features: DATABASE CHANGES: TWO NEW TABLES, ONE SETTING AND ONE COLUMN, NO DATA CHANGES — The update runs the new migrations by itself. Two new tables are created, empty: the devices each user signs in from (for the new-device sign-in notice) and the end-of-year readings of the sub-meters. One new setting, off by default: mandatory two-step verification for whoever enters the admin panel. A new column on invoice lines remembers the item of a charge to a single unit, for invoices recorded or edited from now on. No migration changes the data you already have. No new permission; only the description of «Accesso pannello amministratore» (admin panel access) changes. Server requirements do not change.

CHANGED: WHO CAN DO WHAT IN THE PANEL — «Accesso pannello amministratore» (admin panel access) can be granted only by an administrator. Uploading a file in the management area (an invoice or its XML, a letter, the dispensation, a repayment agreement, the financial statement) requires «Crea documenti archivio» (create archive documents), and whoever lacks it does not see the buttons. Editing a unit and its documents, buildings, staircases, tables and millesimal shares requires «Modifica condomini» (edit condominiums): before, panel access was enough. The default collaborator already has both permissions. Document categories require the archive permissions; an approved draft is published by whoever has «Pubblica comunicazioni» (publish communications); a report can be assigned only to someone who can see reports; a condominium owner cannot touch the office's tasks. «Impostazioni» (settings) opens for whoever has at least one tab: the collaborator sees «Utenti» (users).

CHANGED: MANDATORY TWO-STEP VERIFICATION AND THE NEW SIGN-IN NOTICE — In the general settings you can require two-step verification for whoever enters the panel: those who have not turned it on are sent to turn it on before going on, you included, and while the setting is on it cannot be turned off. Owners and suppliers enter the portal as always. Whoever signs in from a device the program does not know receives the email «Nuovo accesso al tuo account» (new sign-in to your account): the first sign-in after the update records the device without an email, and the notice starts with the first sign-in from another device, or from a browser that does not keep cookies.

CHANGED: SUSPENDED USERS NO LONGER RECEIVE NOTIFICATIONS — A suspended user no longer receives the program's notifications. Letters, receipts, settlement sheets, meeting notices and security notices are sent as always, and so are the offsetting notice and the first sign-in email.

CHANGED: THE SELLER AND THE CONDOMINIUM — In a sale there is the box «Chi vende e il condominio» (the seller and the condominium) with the checkbox «Togli … dal condominio» (remove … from the condominium), already ticked if the seller has no other unit left: once removed, the seller is no longer among the people of the condominium and no longer sees it in the portal, but the remaining instalments are still collected and the statement of account still opens. If you cancel the sale, the seller is back among the people of the condominium. In a collection you can also choose as payer someone who still has instalments in a plan of the condominium. For anyone you remove, the file for the lawyer and “Rimborsa il credito” (refund the credit) are still available.

CHANGED: THE ADDRESS BOOK NO LONGER DELETES SHARES — From a person's record you can no longer remove a condominium where the person has shares to pay or in credit, an ongoing ownership or opening balances not yet in an instalment plan: the message says how many shares and where. A person with shares, balances, credits or ownership rows in any condominium cannot be deleted: before, deleting removed their shares. Whoever has only closed ownership rows stays in the address book.

CHANGED: INSTALMENT PLAN FIGURES IN FOUR CASES, ONLY FOR PLANS GENERATED OR RECALCULATED FROM NOW ON — Plans already generated stay as they are. (1) The days with no owner between two owners written by hand, without a transfer, are no longer paid by the newcomer: they stay to be assigned, with the notice «Quote non assegnate» (unassigned shares), and the program asks you to correct the start date if the newcomer owns the unit since the sale. (2) If a unit has its own «già versato» (already paid) and a person of the unit has one in their name on the same work, the unit's is deducted first and then the person's, as in the transfer settlement; what a person paid in excess stays in their name. (3) An expense charged directly to a single unit follows the item it is written on: it goes to whoever that item belongs to in that period, also under usufruct. (4) A current expense of a single unit, without a period, is paid by whoever was the owner on the invoice date; an expense from before the year, or a previous-years one, without a period, is split over this year's days, and the cart says that to charge whoever was the owner back then you write the period on the invoice. The «già versato» can also be put in the name of whoever sold.

CHANGED: THE PER-PERSON FINAL ACCOUNT IS RE-READ WITH TODAY'S RULES — The per-person final account and the settlement sheet split the expense of a single unit without a period as the plan does. The final account is calculated every time you open it: re-reading a closed year or one with an approved financial statement, in this case the figures may change, and the comparison says so. The approved version of the financial statement stays saved as it was.

CHANGED: AN ITEM ALREADY REQUESTED IN FULL IS NOT REQUESTED AGAIN — If the other instalment plans of the same year already request the whole amount of an item, a new plan does not request it a second time: the program refuses it and says how much is left to request, and with the amount left empty the plan takes only what is left. It applies when the plan is created, when you recalculate it with new items and when you move it to another year. For an expense higher than the budget you record the invoice and the supplementary plan requests the difference.

CHANGED: THE INSTALMENT PLAN, IN SEVERAL PLACES — The plan page now says which year it belongs to, with «Cambia» (change) for a plan without issued instalments, collections or settlement, and the list of plans shows only those of the year. A chapter without its own amount is worth its sub-accounts, as in the instalments. «Sposta spesa» (move expense) refuses the moves that changed the plan total, and in extraordinary plans it is gone, like the item's bin, which removed nothing. An item at € 0 put into instalments from the invoice stays in that plan and the page says so. «Prepara il piano di ripianamento» (prepare the recovery plan) leads to a plan that can be saved. A unit's overdue amount no longer uses another person's credit. With the due date on the 29th or 30th and the advanced recurrence, the instalment falls on that day (or the last day of short months), for new plans. A table with coefficient 0 is refused.

CHANGED: THE CREDIT IN THE STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT, MANAGEMENT BY MANAGEMENT — «Credito disponibile» (available credit) is the net on issued instalments, management by management: with € 120.00 of credit on the ordinary management and € 200.00 to pay on the works, the statement says «€ 200,00 da versare» (to pay) on the works and «€ 120,00 di credito» (credit) on the ordinary, not a net between the two; the gross stays written in small print, also in the PDF. Another person's credit never reduces the debt. «Rimborsa il credito» (refund the credit) for someone who still has to pay asks «Rimborsi lo stesso?» (refund anyway?).

CHANGED: A PARTIAL PAYMENT ON AN INSTALMENT CONTAINING LAST YEAR'S DEBT — When an instalment also contains a part of last year's debt, a partial payment pays that part first, within the instalment it is allocated to. The financial statement for the owners (owners' position and credits), «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments) and the credits printout put that part among previous years, with its age.

CHANGED: THE ACCOUNTS AND THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT — The card «Crediti da riallineare» (credits to realign) now writes the correction of single-unit expenses charged twice in an old plan, with a preview and your confirmation: in a closed year it writes it in the open year, dated today, and the closed year does not change; no owner's debt changes. In the financial statement the new row «Rettifica di esercizi precedenti» (adjustment of previous years) shows it separately. An item or a chart of accounts with journal entries cannot be deleted («stornali prima, o lascia la voce»: reverse them first, or keep the item). A new item must have the type of its chapter, and income under an expense chapter appears in the accrual summary. The immediate adjustment accepts only the items of its management and warns if the date is outside the season. The reversal of an adjustment or a transfer, within the same year, carries the original's date. Issuing with a zero share and a single-unit expense no longer stops.

CHANGED: THE CLOSED YEAR AND THE NEW ONE — Without an open year, a collection says «Non c'è un esercizio aperto: riapri l'esercizio o creane uno nuovo» (there is no open year: reopen it or create a new one) instead of an error page, and the header says «Nessun esercizio aperto» (no open year). A new year is created with the ordinary management (the first active one, and the message says which). A collection entirely from credit no longer asks for the financial resource.

CHANGED: OWNERSHIP TRANSFERS AND HEIRS — An heir who is also heir of another deceased person, on the same unit, passes their share to their own heirs, with per-person figures and the Wallet. A stop already settled from the Wallet with the exact figure counts as settled in the following sales, except for whoever buys back their share. The arrears of whoever leaves, in the transfer panel, is the figure of their debt position. The ancillary charges statement closes the agreement between the parties when one of them leaves, and the printout says so. An appurtenance with two rows of the same person closes the one with the share, or asks you to correct the history. The plan page says who gets an item on the «Proprietario» (owner) of a unit under usufruct.

NEW: END-OF-YEAR READINGS — In the chart-of-accounts item, at year end, for each table you write the sub-meter reading (kWh, m³) or the percentage, and at most one table «per differenza» (by difference) from the main meter: the settlement splits the expense with them, the instalments already requested do not change. They can be written also with the approved plan; not in a closed year.

NEW: BALANCES TO COLLECT WITHOUT ITEMS, PLANS THAT CHANGE AND CLOSED ROWS — In the opening balances page, «Rendi incassabili questi saldi» (make these balances collectable) opens an instalment plan already filled in with the balances only. After correcting a unit's share, the program lists the plans that would request different figures, with «Apri il piano» (open the plan) and «Crea l'addebito» (create the charge). In a unit's history «Correggi questa riga» (correct this row) corrects a row closed by hand, and the unit list flags closed rows at 0 % that leave days paid by nobody.

NEW: THE GENERAL SETTINGS IN THREE CARDS AND THE GUIDE — The general settings are in three boxes (program and access, reports and communications, security), with the «Guida» (guide) drawer in the header. The instalment plan header fits on one line, the end-of-year readings have one card per table, the plan's «Emissione» (issuing) guide is in steps, and the menus of the settings and of the «già versato» are like the others of the program.

NEW: ADDING MANY UNITS IN A ROW — In «Nuova associazione» (new association) there are «Salva e aggiungi un'altra persona» (save and add another person) and, for those with «Modifica condomini», «Salva e crea un nuovo immobile» (save and create a new unit). In «Nuovo immobile» (new unit) the main button is on the right, and units without an internal number or a floor no longer show an empty «Int.» or «Piano». Proposed and written by Federico D'Eredità: thank you.

FIXED: MESSAGES, SECURITY AND SMALL THINGS — A failure shows «L'operazione non è riuscita per un problema del programma» (the operation failed because of a program problem) with a reference, no longer the technical text, and reasons and descriptions no longer go into the technical log. The chart of accounts and the opening balances no longer accept a management or a person of another condominium. Editing an event or a document no longer changes its author or its approval; «Ad uso interno» (internal use) on unit documents is saved. In a user's record the permissions also given by the role stay visible, and a role's name no longer changes on saving. The home page no longer loads a font from an external site. The program's libraries are at their latest corrective versions, with the security fixes. The “already paid” page is now readable in the dark theme too.
